name: Cloudflare Najaf edge data center / network location

name: Nineveh Governorate digital infrastructure partnership with Uptime Institute
notes: Uptime Institute announced an MOU signed July 17, 2026 to advance resilient, globally aligned digital infrastructure in Nineveh and position the governorate as a technology/investment hub. No named facility, site, or capacity was disclosed.
